script: Spread and total were not saved for LV@NO, so the script is inferred only from the two-game form. Las Vegas has given Ashton Jeanty 44 carries for 150 yards, and Kirk Cousins is -0.15 EPA per dropback versus the blitz (19 dropbacks) against +0.20 with no blitz, while New Orleans blitzes 29% and has allowed 4.96 yards per carry plus 9 runs of 10+, so the Raiders should stay on the ground. New Orleans' carries are split — Travis Etienne 18/71, Tyler Shough 12/32, Kendre Miller 9/30, Alvin Kamara 9/15 — into a Las Vegas front that has allowed 4.02 YPC and only 5 runs of 10+, while Chris Olave already has 23 targets for 268 yards, so the Saints' path is the pass.
who_goes_off: Ashton Jeanty should go off on the ground: 22 carries and 75 rush yards a game already, into a Saints defense allowing 4.96 YPC and 9 runs of 10 or more. Juwan Johnson should go off as the intermediate target: 11 targets, 120 yards, 10.9 yards per target over two games, against a Las Vegas defense that has allowed 10.7 yards per attempt on 10 middle throws.
weak_spot: New Orleans' real hole is the run fit, not the perimeter: 4.96 YPC allowed and 9 runs of 10+, while the pass defense has allowed only 4 plays of 20+ on 73 attempts and 5.3 YPA to the right (27 attempts) versus 7.8 in the middle (15 attempts). Las Vegas' hole is the middle of the field at 10.7 YPA on 10 attempts, versus 7.43 left (23 attempts) and 6.38 right (21 attempts) — linebackers, nickel and safeties, not the outside corners.
injury_fallout: No injury report was saved for LV@NO. In the usage that was saved, Brock Bowers is absent from the Las Vegas target log and listed nan on the board, while Michael Mayer has the tight-end work at 11 targets for 55 yards and 46 air yards; New Orleans has Etienne ahead of Kamara in carries, 18 to 9.
qb_vs_blitz: Kirk Cousins at -0.15 EPA versus the blitz, with New Orleans blitzing 29%, should push Las Vegas toward Jeanty runs and Mayer/Jeanty checkdowns rather than Tre Tucker's 193 air yards on 11 targets (17.5 per target). Tyler Shough is +0.04 EPA versus the blitz on 37 dropbacks and +0.12 with no blitz, and Las Vegas blitzes only 21%, so Shough mostly sees the look he has handled and can keep feeding Olave (23 targets, 268 yards) and Johnson (11 targets, 120 yards).

picks.why: Jeanty has 44 carries and 150 rush yards in the two logged games, 75.0 a game, already over 69.5, at only 3.41 YPC. New Orleans has allowed 4.96 YPC and 9 runs of 10+, so that 22-carry volume at even 3.5 YPC is 77 yards, and Cousins' -0.15 EPA versus a 29% blitz keeps the ball on the ground.

Johnson has 11 targets, 120 receiving yards and 88 air yards across two games — 60.0 yards a game and 8.0 air yards per target — against a 35.5 line. Las Vegas has allowed 10.7 YPA on middle attempts, the only location above 7.5, and Shough's +0.12 EPA when not blitzed fits another intermediate share into that middle.
